recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy composite image featuring a group of diverse teenagers in mid-air jumping over a bright blue swimming pool, framed by a thick yellow border and anchored by dark purple header/footer sections containing bold, stylized typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic central action against a static, high-contrast background
Color-coded character outfits contrasting with the cyan pool water
Top-left and bottom-right diagonal balance of primary branding elements
Yellow framing device containing the central photographic action
coreInvariants: Bright cyan water texture with white splash effects
Dark purple curved header and footer blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six teenagers arranged in a horizontal line across the center, scaled to occupy 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark purple oval in the top-left and the rounded square badge in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left branding, follows the arc of the jumping teens from left to right, and settles on the bottom-right title badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with subjects and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan/Blue (pool water) providing the primary background energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark Purple (header/footer) providing structural weight and legibility for text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Yellow (frame and text) used for high-visibility highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all hues; high value in the center with deep value at the top and bottom edges.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with rounded corners
Tight letter spacing (kerning) with occasional overlaps
Horizontal bars often replaced with stylized icons (e.g., microphone cord)
Mixed case with emphasis on heavy, blocky capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a horizontal bar extending into a microphone cord
Large numerals with inner beveling or texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display fonts paired with clean, medium-weight sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence.
Matches the rounded, friendly but heavy aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-energy photo of a group of diverse teenagers in colorful summer clothes jumping joyfully over a bright blue swimming pool with splashing water. Frame the scene with a thick, rounded yellow border. Add a dark purple curved header at the top and a dark purple footer at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif text in white and yellow. Place the main series title in a purple oval at the top-left and the specific title in a white-bordered blue badge at the bottom-right. Add metadata text in the purple footer using a clean sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow frame consistent in thickness?
Are the teenagers in mid-air with visible splashes?
Is the purple header/footer color deep and saturated?
Does the typography feel heavy and 'bubbly'?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the yellow frame.
Check that the splash effects look integrated with the subjects.
Verify the purple sections are dark enough for white text legibility.
Confirm the 'jumping' poses look natural and energetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dynamic Group Action] + [Vibrant Water Background] + [Thick Yellow Frame] + [Dark Purple Header/Footer] + [Ultra-Bold Rounded Typography].
